planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno; physical wiring preserved: A0 (analog input), D9 (LED output), D6 (buzzer). No other explicit wired roles were provided, so no additional ports are created.
LED is modeled as a boolean digital output with catalog default polarity (assumed active_high true in catalog sense). SysML should drive it true when A0 > 700, false otherwise.

Buzzer uses tone_output with initial 0 (silence). Exact tone frequency/duration policy is a business/model decision and is not specified in the provided requirements; SysML must choose how long/at what frequency when A0 > 700.

Control period chosen as 5 ms as a safe default scheduling granularity since no deadlines were specified. Threshold evaluation and output updates occur each control step; analog sampling may be used directly each step.
No serial receive/transmit requirements were specified; therefore serial_channels is empty.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: A0 threshold source: if > 700 then trigger LED full-on and buzzer alarm

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: LED full-on alarm output (ON when A0 > 700)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer alarm tone output (active when A0 > 700); frequency controlled in SysML
